topic: Every full node checks every block itself
hook: Miners can't force Bitcoin to accept a bad block.

scenes.narration: Each full node validates blocks on its own, using the same consensus rules.
Nodes accept a block only if every transaction in it is valid and not already spent.
Finding a valid block is hard, but checking its proof of work is cheap.
Nobody needs to trust a miner's word. The network can check the work.

cta: Did that surprise you? Tell me below, and see my description for more.
title: Why Miners Can't Force a Bad Bitcoin Block
description_body: Full nodes validate blocks independently, and proof of work is hard to find but cheap to check.
